from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# try a more focused mutation around the frame footer and chunk table offsets
for i in range(128, 512):
    b[i] = (b[i] + (i % 251)) & 0xFF
for i in range(len(b)-1024, len(b)-128):
    b[i] = (b[i] ^ 0xFF) & 0xFF
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('len', len(b))
